name: dry-build all six configs
command: cd ~/olympus-nixos || exit 1; fail=0; for c in nyx-nixos aether-nixos ariadne-nixos athena-nixos circe-nixos dionysus-nixos; do echo "=== $c ==="; if nix build ".#$c.config.system.build.toplevel" --dry-run >"/tmp/dry-$c.log" 2>&1; then echo "EVAL OK: $c"; else echo "EVAL FAIL: $c"; fail=1; tail -40 "/tmp/dry-$c.log"; fi; done; echo "OVERALL: $([ $fail -eq 0 ] && echo ALL_OK || echo SOME_FAILED)"
